summary: Customer ordering and admin permissions system (including ban checks and admin role delegation).
architectural_notes: Review/define role-based access control rules: owner vs admin permissions (including who can assign admin role).
known_issues: Customers cannot place orders due to ban-status check failing (error: can't check if they're banned).

existing_features.title: Fix the customer order flow so authenticated, non-banned users can create orders without failing due to a ban-status pre-check (current error: cannot check if they are banned).

new_feature_requests.summary: Allow any admin (not just owner) to grant admin access to other users.

Add/adjust backend ban-check APIs so the frontend can reliably determine ban status for the currently authenticated caller without requiring admin permissions (e.g., a query like isCallerBanned()), and ensure order creation still enforces the ban server-side.
Update backend authorization for admin delegation so any authenticated admin (not just the owner) can grant admin access to another user by email via the existing admin-access API used by the UI.

Update backend authorization for admin delegation so any authenticated admin (not just the owner) can revoke admin access by email via the existing admin-access API used by the UI, while preventing removal of the owner’s admin access.

projectName: Fix customer ordering ban-check failure and allow any admin to delegate admin access
